email.subject: CoastAir's site on phones
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I checked CoastAir Co's website. On a phone, the layout doesn't adjust to the screen, so most mobile visitors are stuck pinching and zooming to read anything or find a phone number. Since most people search for HVAC help on their phone, especially during a heating or cooling emergency, that's likely turning into calls to a competitor instead.

The page also doesn't list your hours, so visitors can't tell if you're open before reaching out.

I fix exactly this for local service businesses, flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing what's costing you calls?

Alex
Northlight Web
